items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Well I eat around there by Miss So and So. You go around there by Miss So and So's little place, you get a better meal and cost you less money.

ctx.x: I'd always let the band go where they're going. Then I'd go around, hit some of the bars. Look like, see a fella look like he's in the know. Then I'd go up and ask him, where do he eat? He'd say, oh right down there they got the chicken shack or so and so's resting. But I'd say, now where do you eat? Well I eat around there by Miss So and So.
